draft.shortGloss: to place; to put down; to set
draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and calm, setting an object down on a surface
notes: Do not confuse with ใส่ (sài), which is used for putting things into a container or putting on clothes and accessories.
Often used in everyday compounds like วางแผน (waang-phǎen, 'to plan') and วางสาย (waang-sǎai, 'to hang up the phone').
